rule_0.statement: THE SEAT LAW: the seating pair is not 'the lowest paw' (a geometric accident) but the pair whose support polygon CONTAINS the CoM with margin (the statics-stability condition). The owed hind-reset repair (wave 16, verified to 0.07 mm) moved the right hind to its 0.5 clock column, and THAT flips the containment: on the corrected assembly the CoM sits INSIDE the hind pair's polygon. THE DERIVATION (derive_seat_law.py, Assembly-exact): (1) THE PAIR TABLE -- hind pair [x -0.1763, +0.2223] CONTAINS the CoM (entry-state x 0.02681) with span margins 0.2032 rear / 0.1955 front (standing-CoM 0.02319: 0.1995/0.1991 -- nearly centered); fore pair FAILS containment (-0.3195: the measured wave-16 tip-over); diag LH+RF FAILS containment (-0.1129); diag RH+LF contains on paper (min span margin 0.2031, +7.5 mm over the hind pair) BUT is unrealizable as a distinct seat -- the L/R fore pads are mirror-locked (one shared shoulder/elbow pose), so seating a fore pad seats BOTH, and any state where the R MP and the pads are on the plane reduces to the hind seat with the pads kissing at ~zero load; its tick-0 price, if it WERE real, is a 23.67 N fore-pad load = 3.856 N.m = 0.91 of the 4.229 cap -- the wave-16 death's load path at 91% of cap as the cost of 7.5 mm of extra margin. THE SEATED PAIR IS THE HIND PAIR, the unique containing, realizable, capacity-feasible pair. (2) THE HIND STATICS AT THE SEAT: the hind pair bears the full weight at tick 0 (the fore pads kiss at +2e-6 with no preload); the two vertical reactions solve exactly from the unactuated base rows: 52.42 N left (0.533 W) / 46.02 N right (0.467 W); the worst joint demand is the right knee at ratio 0.584 <= 1 (caps hip 11.2125 / knee 6.6375 / ankle 7.4 / MP 0.8875 N.m; the wave-8 single-support prior 0.92-0.95 at theta* scales to ~0.5 W per leg) -- the wave-1 stance-hold law CONFIRMED on the corrected assembly at the seated pose. The re-pinned pads KISS the plane at tick 0: the derived FORE TOUCH TICK IS 0, and the load TRANSFERS to them through the settle as the loaded hind struts compress (the compliance anchor: the wave-16 settle landed a 4.58 cm hind dangle by ~tick 30).
